pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karonti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karissanti seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhogino”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karissantī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.8: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karothāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.14.1: na udake uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:1.15: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānā bhikkhū udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi kātuṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.4: “anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi kātuṃ”
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.5: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.6.1: na udake agilāno uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.7: na udake agilānena uccāro vā passāvo vā kheḷo vā kātabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.8: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca udake agilāno uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karoti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk75:2.22: uddānaṃ: ‘parimaṇḍalaṃ paṭicchannaṃ susaṃvutokkhittacakkhunā ukkhittujjagghikappasaddo tayo ceva pacālanā khamha oguṇṭhitā ceva kuṭipallatthikāya ca, sakkaccaṃ pattasaññī ca samasūpasamatittikaṃ. sakkaccaṃ pattayasaññi ca sapadāna samasūpakaṃ, thūpato ca paṭicchannaṃ viññattujjhānasaññinā. na mahantaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dvāraṃ sabbaṃ hatthaṃ na byāharare, ukkhepo chedanaṃ gaṇḍaṃ dhunaṃ sitthāvakārakaṃ. jivhānicchārakaṃ ceva vapussuru surena ca, hattho patto ca oṭṭho ca sāmisañca sasitthakaṃ. chattapāṇissa saddhammaṃ na desenti tathāgatā, icceva daṇḍapāṇissa satthaāyudhapāṇinaṃ. pādukopāhanā ceva yānā seyyagatassa ca, pallatthikā nisinnassa veṭhitoguṇṭhitassa ca chamā nīcāsane ṭhānaṃ pacchato uppathena ca. ṭhitakena na kātabbaṃ harite udakamhi cāti. tesaṃ vaggānaṃ uddānaṃ: parimaṇḍalaṃ ujjagasi khambhaṃ sakkaccameva ca, kabaḷāsuru surū ceva pādukena ca sattamāti. paññattā atidevena gotamena yassasinā, sāvake sikkhanatthāya pañcasattati sekhiyāti. uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto sekhiyā dhammā.
